description: One simple short tan wooden measuring ruler UI icon angled from lower left to upper right, dark brown measurement tick marks along one edge. Warm beige wood and dark brown outline, no numbers. Single isolated icon centered, crisp clean 16-bit pixel art, 3 shades per color, dark brown one-pixel contour, clear silhouette readable at 20 pixels, transparent background, 4 pixel transparent margin on every edge, no shadow cast outside object, no panel, no background scene.
color_palette: dark brown outline, warm tan and brass gold, cream highlights
